image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a black rectangular loudspeaker enclosure resting on a wooden surface. The speaker features a large central woofer with a metallic-looking cone and rubber surround, two smaller circular drivers (tweeters/mid-range) stacked vertically to the left, and a bass reflex port at the bottom left. Four corner screws secure the faceplate.
